entry.title: The Chief Executive's 2026 Policy Address — International Financial Centre
entry.summary: The Policy Address says the HKMA will introduce a seven-day offshore RMB liquidity tender mechanism, explore offshore RMB short-term debt instruments, and encourage more foreign banks in Hong Kong to join CIPS directly. It is market-development direction, not a stated binding requirement or timetable for authorised institutions.

entry.title: Crypto firms get guidance on how the new regime applies
entry.summary: The FCA says its future UK cryptoasset-regime guidance explains which activities may require authorisation, including qualifying-stablecoin issuance, platform operation, dealing or arranging, safeguarding and arranging staking. Applications open on 30 September 2026 and the regime is due to enter force on 25 October 2027; this is a UK benchmark, not a Hong Kong requirement.

entry.title: Policy Address signals future consultation on AI-enabled fraudulent content
entry.summary: The Hong Kong Government says the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau will consult later in 2026 on expanding a legal framework to encourage technology and telecommunications sectors to improve detection and removal of potentially fraudulent online content, including AI-generated content. The announcement states no consultation date, final scope, implementation date or bank duty.

entry.title: SFC circular on Haiti and Yemen sanctions amendments
entry.summary: The SFC reported that the Haiti and Yemen sanctions amendment regulations were gazetted on 11 September 2026 with immediate effect. The underlying regulations are required within their legal scope; the circular addresses licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities and does not state a new obligation for authorised institutions generally.

entry.title: Circular on Private Market Investments
entry.summary: HKMA published a current circular on private market investments for Registered Institutions, classified under securities/investment products; registered evidence does not expose its operative text.

entry.title: Consultation on Phase 2B prototype of Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance
entry.summary: HKMA opened a Phase 2B Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance consultation for all authorised institutions; comments close on 7 October 2026.

entry.title: Second Reading of the Scams (Countermeasures) and Other Matters Bill – Wrap-Up Speech
entry.summary: Singapore's Ministry of Home Affairs described proposed scam-countermeasure orders and said local banks will offer an LPBA or alternative basic account from October 2026, with no exact date stated.

entry.title: DBS, OCBC and UOB complete first live tokenised-deposit transactions on Swift’s ledger
entry.summary: DBS, OCBC and UOB announced that they completed live domestic Singapore-dollar interbank transactions using tokenised deposits on Swift’s blockchain-based ledger. The banks say the work provides insights for round-the-clock interbank payments and may support future corporate treasury, trade and digital-commerce services; it is not a Hong Kong regulatory requirement or a confirmed customer rollout.

entry.title: Circular on Private Market Investments
entry.summary: HKMA reminded registered institutions distributing publicly or privately offered products with private-credit or private-equity exposure to apply product due diligence, appropriate risk ratings, clear risk disclosure, suitability controls, monitoring and staff training. The circular states no source deadline and preserves existing institutional and qualified-corporate professional-investor exemptions.

entry.title: Record year for investment product sales in Hong Kong with robust demand for FICC-related products: SFC-HKMA joint survey 2025
entry.summary: The HKMA and SFC reported that 2025 non-exchange-traded investment-product sales reached HK$9.9 trillion, up 63% year on year; online sales were 21% of aggregate transaction value and currency-linked product sales were HK$698 billion. The release reports survey results and states no new deadline or requirement.

entry.title: HKMA launches public consultation on Phase 2B prototype of Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance
entry.summary: HKMA is consulting on the Phase 2B prototype of the Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance, which adds 10 economic activities and includes green, transition and climate-adaptation elements. Comments are invited by 7 October 2026.

entry.title: Early Alert on United Nations Sanctions
entry.summary: The SFC expects licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities to update customer- and payment-screening databases for two UN sanctions-list amendments. It states no deadline.

entry.title: Powering Next Wave of Market Growth through AI and RMB Internationalisation
entry.summary: The SFC’s 4 September 2026 news record links to its Chief Executive’s speech synopsis, which says the SFC is considering guidance on applying existing principles to agentic-AI use cases. The synopsis identifies ownership and human oversight, controlled access and defined scope, testing and monitoring, operational resilience, and escalation and remediation as relevant outcomes, but announces no final guidance, deadline or prescribed technology design.

entry.title: Remote on-boarding of individual customers
entry.summary: HKMA updated supervisory expectations for remote onboarding of individual customers by authorised institutions and stored value facility licensees. The circular expects ongoing use of fraud and scam intelligence, continual solution updates and recalibration, reliable identity-document authentication, identity matching, and a comprehensive effectiveness review.

entry.title: Circular on SFC-authorised funds with exposure to private market assets
entry.summary: The SFC requires enhanced offering-document disclosures for affected public funds with direct or indirect exposure to private market assets. Funds with aggregate direct and indirect exposure of 50% or more of NAV will be considered complex products, and existing fund managers are expected to review funds, update documents as soon as practicable, and communicate properly with distributors.

entry.title: Early Alert on United Nations Sanctions
entry.summary: The SFC published AML/CFT circular 26EC53 on 28 August 2026 for licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities. Available official metadata identifies a sanctions-related alert but does not establish operative requirements, deadlines or broader authorised-institution applicability.

entry.title: BEA Signs Memorandum of Understanding with Anchorpoint to Explore Real-World HKD-backed Stablecoin Applications
entry.summary: BEA and Anchorpoint announced an exploratory memorandum on 28 August 2026 to consider HKDAP-enabled digital-asset initiatives, including payment and settlement use cases. The joint announcement does not announce a launched product, regulatory action or deadline.

entry.title: First cohort of GenA.I. Sandbox++
entry.summary: Four Hong Kong financial regulators announced the first GenA.I. Sandbox++ cohort for controlled testing of selected agentic-AI use cases; participation is not an industry-wide obligation.

entry.title: Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Taskforce holds its second meeting
entry.summary: HKMA and HKAB announced continuing work on financing models and risk mitigants for Northern Metropolis projects; this is a prospective commercial opportunity rather than a financing requirement or commitment.

entry.title: Employers' data in loan applications: PCPD findings
entry.summary: The Privacy Commissioner's Office found misuse of employers' personal data in loan applications and advised financial institutions to remain vigilant, without finding that a lender breached the PDPO or creating a new lender rule.
